messages:
elaine: Quick kickoff for the KV-eviction recurring-pattern follow-up. Goal: convert postmortem actions into automated tests and a safe staging drill. Two-week sprint starting Mon. Need owners for: prompt/regression suite, load-replay, and chaos + gating.

hugo: Ill take the prompt/regression suite. Plan: collect 20 failing prompts from traces, add token-size metadata, and wire into nightly evals. Target Wed EOD.

sam: I can own load-replay. Prefer sanitized incident replay for fidelity; will generate synthetic fallback if PII prevents sharing. Need infra ephemeral runner and CI job. Draft traffic profile Tue AM.

nina: Ill run the chaos drill and write the runbook (KV eviction + fallback verification + rollback checklist). Will schedule a small staging canary for next Thu.

ryan: Infra can stand up a 2-node ephemeral cluster and a short-lived metrics pipeline. Sam, send VUs, session distribution, and retention window. Example runner command to mirror: `k6 run --vus 1500 --duration 20m script.js --out influxdb`.

elaine: Proposed gates to codify in the pipeline: if KV-eviction > 0.08% OR model-fallback > 0.4% over 24h -> block rollout + escalate. Owners, please include gate checks in PRs.

hugo: Will include gate checks and test metadata (expected P95, token thresholds) in the regression suite. Acceptance: P95 < 220ms and error rate < 0.6% on replay window.

sam: For replay vs synthetic: replay preferred for session timing fidelity. If sanitization takes time, synthetic must match token length histogram and inter-arrival.

ops-bot: Created board card: "EV-Pattern -> tests sprint" assigned to elaine - https://boards.redwood.internal/pm/321 (automated)

nina: I'll draft the runbook with explicit abort/rollback commands and monitoring knobs. Also adding a checklist for canary scale and safety timeout.

elaine: Standups Mon/Wed/Fri 9:30 for quick unblock checks. I'll add cards and calendar invites. Update the board if timelines slip or you need traces access.
